note: Both sets share the same four misbound keynote codes (A4, A1, B4, B1 are shifted one beam off relative to the sheet keynotes), and both correctly capture the W10X15/W8X13 sections and the 1/2" opening edge radius note. Set B correctly names the C1 beam as "ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6 & NEAR GRID 5", whereas Set A truncates it to "ROOF BEAM @ GRID 6" and also adds a redundant duplicate of the E6 roof beam claim. Set B is therefore cleaner and more faithful with no extra noise.
